name: usage-bar
description: Band above the prompt, on two lines, one or hidden: Claude quotas (session, week, Fable) with resets, projection and alerts, context, session cost, git state, weekly pace, running subagents, and buttons to /model, /context, /usage and /cost

resetStyle.title: Reset style
resetStyle.description: How a window's reset is shown: the delay left (delay) or the time of day (time).

warnPercent.title: Warning threshold
warnPercent.description: Percentage from which a gauge takes the warning color.

dangerPercent.title: Danger threshold
dangerPercent.description: Percentage from which a gauge takes the danger color.

quotaAlerts.title: Quota alerts
quotaAlerts.description: Comma-separated percentages at which a quota raises an alert. Empty: no alert.

contextAlerts.title: Context alerts
contextAlerts.description: Comma-separated percentages at which the context window raises an alert. Empty: no alert.

projectionAlertMinutes.title: Projection alert
projectionAlertMinutes.description: Minutes before the session quota is projected full from which an alert is raised (0 to 600). 0: no alert.

projectionMinPercent.title: Projection from
projectionMinPercent.description: Session percentage from which the band shows the projection (0 to 100). 0: always. The projection alert does not depend on it.

colorOk.title: Color: ok
colorOk.description: Color of a gauge under the warning threshold (a name or #rrggbb).

colorWarn.title: Color: warning
colorWarn.description: Color of a gauge from the warning threshold (a name or #rrggbb).

colorDanger.title: Color: danger
colorDanger.description: Color of a gauge from the danger threshold (a name or #rrggbb).

background.title: Background
background.description: Background color of the band (a name or #rrggbb).

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: How the band is drawn: two lines (full), a single line (compact), or not at all (hidden).

showGit.title: Show working tree
showGit.description: Show the uncommitted files and lines.

showProjection.title: Show projection
showProjection.description: Show when the session quota is projected to run out.

showPace.title: Show weekly pace
showPace.description: Show how far the week's usage runs ahead of or behind an even pace.
